howto.what: 每次 Read、Edit、Bash 都会被记录成压缩后的观察项,会话结束时统一汇总;相关的观察项会自动注入之后的对话,让新会话带着上次的上下文开始,不用重新解释代码库。
howto.when: 在同一个项目里,记忆注入从你的第二次会话开始;第一次会话只负责种下记忆。也可以运行 /learn-codebase 一次性把整个仓库读进记忆(约 5 分钟,可选)。

say.note: 讲清记录、注入和存放位置

say.text: 这个工具现在在做什么?
运行 /learn-codebase 把整个仓库读进记忆

howto.what_en: Every Read, Edit and Bash becomes a compressed observation. Observations are summarized at session end and relevant ones are auto-injected into later prompts, so a new session starts with context from the last one.
howto.when_en: Injection starts on your second session in a project; the first session seeds memory. /learn-codebase can front-load the whole repo in one pass (~5 minutes, optional).

say_en.note: Explains capture, injection and data location

say_en.text: What is this thing doing right now?
Run /learn-codebase to load the whole repo into memory
